Question B-003-010-011.

Why the correct answer is right: A continuous wave (CW) audio band-pass centred around an 800 Hz tone passes the desired note while rejecting lower and higher audio noise.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "2100 Hz to 2300 Hz": 2 100 Hz to 2 300 Hz is centred much higher than the common CW pitch range used here.
- sourceIndex 2: "300 Hz to 2700 Hz": 300 Hz to 2 700 Hz is a voice-like audio range and too wide to be an optimum CW band-pass.
- sourceIndex 3: "100 Hz to 1100 Hz": 100 Hz to 1 100 Hz includes the CW tone but also admits much more low-frequency noise and adjacent audio than the narrower 750 Hz to 850 Hz range.
